description: Ministry of Power and Renewable Energy - Order to approve the proposed acquisition of lands in Udumulla and Egoda Kolonnawa, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District required by the Ceylon Electricity Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains orders under the Ceylon Electricity Board Act approving the acquisition of specific lands described in detailed schedules, including land boundaries, extents, and ownership claims. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
